# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP3: 1453 BYZ Streamlined Core Systems + 1648/1776 Restored BYZ Dynamic Bootstrap (0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides, standalone-safe all_eras). Generated by gen_v260_wp3_byz_core.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Populates oe_byz_roman_world base land territory (Anatolia, Balkans minus Slovenia/Istria,
# Wallachia, Apulia, Basilicata) via canonical oe_heg_add_roman_location when created dynamically.
oe_byz_bootstrap_roman_world_land = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
        region:anatolia_region = { every_location_in_region = { oe_heg_add_roman_location = yes } }
        region:balkan_region = { every_location_in_region = { oe_heg_add_roman_location = yes } }
        area:wallachia_area = { every_location_in_area = { oe_heg_add_roman_location = yes } }
        area:apulia_area = { every_location_in_area = { oe_heg_add_roman_location = yes } }
        area:basilicata_area = { every_location_in_area = { oe_heg_add_roman_location = yes } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Idempotent Day-1 1453 streamlined core IO bootstrap (keeps all_eras 100% standalone-safe
# without OEBYZ IO types in setup/1453/15_international_organizations.txt).
# Opens Imperial Pillars (auth 20, opinion 40, 4 initial laws, 0 1337 ruler_term chain),
# 1453 Roman World (16 verified active tags, excluding MOR), and Court Offices (skipping 1337 characters).
# Does NOT create oe_byz_bank_org or oe_byz_policy_org on Day 1 (unlocked via post-Siege milestone decision).
oe_byz_1453_bootstrap_core_ios = {
    oe_ml_mark_start = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
            current_year = 1453
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wp3_1453_bootstrapped }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_wp3_1453_bootstrapped value = 1 }
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
        c:BYZ = {
            save_scope_as = oe_wp3_founder
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } }
                create_international_organization = {
                    type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                    add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    set_leader_country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    international_organization_add_special_status = {
                        type = special_status:oe_pillars_empire
                        country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    }
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_byz_theme_governor_administration
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_justinian_code
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_roman_citizenship
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_land_preemption
                }
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority value = 20 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion value = 40 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_opening_resources_initialized value = yes }
                    oe_pillars_sync_effect = yes
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
                create_international_organization = {
                    type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
                    add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    set_leader_country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    international_organization_add_special_status = {
                        type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_byz
                        country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                    }
                }
                oe_byz_bootstrap_roman_world_land = yes
                international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world ?= {
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:TRE }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FEO c:FEO = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:FEO }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:EPI }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:SER }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:WAL c:WAL = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:WAL }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOL c:MOL = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:MOL }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEO c:GEO = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:GEO }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ATH c:ATH = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:ATH }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CYP c:CYP = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:CYP }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NAX c:NAX = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:NAX }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KNI c:KNI = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:KNI }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:TUR }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:KAR }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:CND }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DUL c:DUL = { oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes } } add_country_to_international_organization = c:DUL }
                    oe_roman_world_sync_effect = yes
                }
            }
            oe_court_initialize = yes
            oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Idempotent Day-1 1453 Morea (R14, location:corinth) theme creation.
# Keeps R01 (constantinople/silivri/catalca) as direct imperial crownland and never touches BYT01/edirne/serres.
oe_byz_1453_found_morea_theme = {
    oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
            NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
            current_year = 1453
            exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp3_1453_morea_founded }
            location:corinth = {
                oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes
                has_variable = oe_theme_region_center
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied }
                NOT = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp3_1453_morea_founded value = 1 }
        location:corinth = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat }
        oe_theme_found_at_seat_empire = yes
        oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
    }
}

# Country scope (newly formed non-1337 BYZ). Idempotent dynamic bootstrap for 1648/1776 Restored BYZ.
# Dynamically founds oe_byz_empire_pillars (auth 25, opinion 50, 4 initial laws), oe_byz_roman_world
# (enrolling all live territorial states in the Roman World + Moldavia), and Court Offices, while
# keeping all 1337 historical storylines permanently locked (oe_start_is_1337 = no).
oe_byz_bootstrap_core_ios = {
    oe_ml_mark_start = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            tag = BYZ
            is_rebel_country = no
            NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
            NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
            NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_wp3_founder
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
        create_international_organization = {
            type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_founder
            set_leader_country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
            international_organization_add_special_status = {
                type = special_status:oe_pillars_empire
                country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
            }
            add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_byz_theme_governor_administration
            add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_justinian_code
            add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_roman_citizenship
            add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_land_preemption
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority value = 25 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion value = 50 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_opening_resources_initialized value = yes }
            oe_pillars_sync_effect = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
            create_international_organization = {
                type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                set_leader_country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                international_organization_add_special_status = {
                    type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_byz
                    country = scope:oe_wp3_founder
                }
            }
            oe_byz_bootstrap_roman_world_land = yes
            if = {
                limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
                international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = { save_scope_as = oe_wp3_rw }
                every_country = {
                    limit = {
                        is_rebel_country = no
                        oe_roman_world_territorial_country_trigger = yes
                        NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_rw }
                        exists = capital
                        capital ?= {
                            OR = {
                                is_owned_by_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_rw
                                area = area:moldavia_area
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = oe_wp3_rw_joiner
                    scope:oe_wp3_rw = {
                        add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_rw_joiner
                    }
                }
                scope:oe_wp3_rw = {
                    oe_roman_world_sync_effect = yes
                }
            }
        }
        oe_court_initialize = yes
        oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Unlocks Imperial Banking Supervision (oe_byz_bank_org) and
# Sacrum Consistorium (oe_byz_policy_org) after surviving the Siege and holding >= 25 locations.
oe_byz_post_siege_unlock_banks_policy = {
    save_scope_as = oe_wp3_emperor
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_bank_org } }
        create_international_organization = {
            type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_bank_org
            add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_emperor
            international_organization_add_special_status = {
                type = special_status:oe_bank_org_byz
                country = scope:oe_wp3_emperor
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_bank_org }
            international_organization:oe_byz_bank_org = { save_scope_as = oe_wp3_bank_io }
            every_subject = {
                limit = { is_subject_type = oe_bank }
                save_scope_as = oe_wp3_bank_sub
                scope:oe_wp3_bank_io = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_wp3_bank_sub = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_bank_io } } }
                        add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_wp3_bank_sub
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { international_organization_has_leader = no }
                        set_leader_country = scope:oe_wp3_bank_sub
                        international_organization_add_special_status = {
                            type = special_status:oe_bank_org_big_bank
                            country = scope:oe_wp3_bank_sub
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes
}
